Reference image for the [[Anagrams]] row on [[Rennek]], whose title is an anagram of Kenner: the logo of Kenner Products, the toy company that made the original Star Wars action figures. Rendered from the SVG at 960 by 261 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 0730e909df9fe52ae50715080c88e8f5a0e552dda3addbcc3abf9b6121b654f5.

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kenner_logo.svg Kenner logo.svg], Wikimedia Commons. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027173014/https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kenner_logo.svg Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

Author: Kenner Products (logo from 1975).

License: Public domain. Wikimedia Commons marks it as a text logo too simple for copyright (PD-textlogo). It may still be a trademark.
